verdict.rationale: Decagon supports natural-language defined rules that trigger actions: Watchtower lets teams define custom criteria (e.g., frustration, policy violations) that automatically flag/surface events, AOPs define natural-language SOPs that drive agent behavior, and proactive agents trigger actions (calls, recommendations) 'based on customer signals.' However, there's no documented general-purpose rules/event engine with explicit trigger-condition-action configuration or webhook-style event hooks. Missing for 10: explicit event/trigger architecture documentation, developer-facing rule-builder API or webhook events, and independent/hands-on confirmation of automation reliability.
